import ctypes
import os

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the result structure
class GSLResult(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('val', ctypes.c_double), ('err', ctypes.c_double)]

# Define the function
def bessel_K0(x):
    if x <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Input must be a positive floating-point number.")
    result = GSLResult()
    status = gsl.gsl_sf_bessel_K0_e(ctypes.c_double(x), ctypes.byref(result))
    if status != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"GSL function call failed with status code {status}")
    return result.val

# Assertion tests
def assert_test():
    assert abs(bessel_K0(0.5) - 0.9244190712276658) < 1e-9, "Test case 1 failed"
    assert abs(bessel_K0(1.0) - 0.421024438240708333) < 1e-9, "Test case 2 failed"
    assert abs(bessel_K0(2.0) - 0.113893872749533435) < 1e-9, "Test case 3 failed"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
